text:
Busy season brings a hopeful watch
Applause for the whole team

Smooth paws, calm flights

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has kept its usual steady rhythm, with checks that help travelers and pets move through Aurelia Skyways with less stress. The safety review keeps an eye on crate fit, paperwork, gentle handoffs, and clear updates, so small issues can be caught early and handled with care. That kind of routine work may look quiet from the outside, but it makes a real difference for passengers and their animals.

This week felt like a good reminder that careful habits matter. From friendly guidance at the counter to sensible follow-through behind the scenes, the team kept things calm and welcoming. That steady attention helps every journey start on the right paw.
